headlines.title: Burnham to unveil public body to invest in electricity grid
headlines.description: The prime minister will say he wants to reduce energy costs in his first conference speech as Labour leader.

headlines.title: OpenAI scraps rollout of new model over safety concerns
headlines.description: The firm also issued an update on incidents in which its models accessed Australian government systems.

headlines.title: UK diesel price hits all-time high, the RAC says
headlines.description: The US-Israel war with Iran has caused fuel prices to soar due to disruption of global oil supplies.

headlines.title: Apple ordered to pay $5.7bn after losing vibration tech patent suit
headlines.description: Audio firm Taction Technology claimed Apple infringed its patents for tech used to power device vibrations.

headlines.title: Avanti West Coast services to be nationalised from March
headlines.description: The move is part of a plan to improve rail infrastructure, cut train delays and improve experiences for passengers.
